ember_source: # Maps Ember's nine electricity sources to EXIOBASE 3.8.2 (pxp) electricity products.
# Used by jobs/prepare_electricity.py to turn observed generation into targets for the
# electricity step of the baseline walk (docs/plans/03-baseline-walk.md).
# One Ember source maps to one EXIOBASE product. Three EXIOBASE electricity products have no
# Ember source of their own and are left as the 2011 table has them: "Electricity by solar
# thermal"
ipcc_variable: ocean" and "Electricity nec". Together they are

ember_source: # under 0.5% of 2011 generation in the table.

# technology reliably (see engine/electricity.py): to that region's other technologies of

# so a row can be set beside any published scenario.
